title: Noodling Nautilus
statement: Drifting gently through a sun-dappled forest of swaying kelp and mossy slate, this thoughtful cephalopod spends its afternoons sorting bits of tumbled sea glass into neat little spirals on the sand. Whenever it finishes a pattern, it admires its work for a moment, lets out a contented puff of bubbles, and happily starts a brand-new design.
